snippet.title: Skin Witch Announcement Trailer - True Survival Horror
snippet.description:
Skin Witch is an upcoming survival-horror game from Blackwood Specter. Trapped in an underground mine you were sent to investigate, you soon find out you're not alone.

Wishlist on Steam now at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164990/Skin_Witch/
